children: UK agricultural group reported H1 revenue down 3% yr/yr due to tea garden disposals
Seasonal trading loss narrowed on cost discipline, efficiency measures and improved yields and pricing
Company completed major non-core asset disposals and advanced four growth projects
Company says full-year results remain difficult to predict due to crop yield and price uncertainty
Camellia expects Bangladesh tea production in 2026 at 13.5-14.5 mln kg and price at Tk230-250/kg
Company sees India bulk tea production for 2026 at 28-30 mln kg and price at Rs245-265/kg
COST DISCIPLINE - Co said improved trading loss was driven by strong cost discipline and efficiency measures
ASSET DISPOSALS - Profits on disposals of non-core assets contributed to overall profitability
OPERATIONAL IMPROVEMENTS - Better yields and pricing in tea businesses helped narrow trading loss
H1 Net Income Attributable to Shareholders
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the fishing & farming peer group is "buy."
The stock recently traded at 194 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 186 three months ago
